loadFailed: Something went wrong. Reload to try again.
loseText: Pull out and try another way in.
restartAsk: Restart this level? It won’t count as a failed try.
howText: Swap two neighbouring tiles to line up three or more of one kind. Four in a line makes a worm, an L or T makes a logic bomb, five makes a zero-day. Swap a special to set it off, or swap two together. Meet every goal before the patrol comes back.
fair: Refills lean your way when you’re behind. Never against you. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Progress stays on this device.
shareText: Override: an ad-free match-3 with endless levels. No ads, no accounts.
licence: Free to play and share for noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0).
font: Fonts: Barlow Semi Condensed and Share Tech Mono, SIL Open Font License.
turnPhone: Turn your phone upright to play.
hintCrack: Encrypted cells. Match next to them to crack them.
hintFirewall: Firewalls hold a tile in place. Match it to free it.
comms1: Maglock on the service door. Crack it and we’re in.
comms2: Badge reader on the loading dock. Make it like us.
comms3: Cage door to the server room. Quietly, please.
comms4: Fire door, alarmed. Kill the alarm, then the lock.
comms5: Cameras on this floor. Give me thirty seconds of dark.
comms6: Motion sensors in the hall. Blind them for me.
comms7: Air-gapped box. Plant the bridge and I’ll do the rest.
comms8: Elevator wants a keycard. Convince it.
comms9: Alarm panel by the stairs. Make it think all is well.
comms10: Vault controller. This is the one we came for.
comms11: Shutter on the way out. Open it and we walk.
comms12: Gate to the yard. The driver’s waiting.
